summary: Phase 2 backend testing complete. 16/16 tests passed (100%). Validated new legal HTML pages (/api/legal/privacy, /api/legal/privacy-policy alias, /api/legal/data-deletion) return HTTP 200 with correct HTML content ('Privacy Policy', 'SpeakMate AI', 'Data Deletion Request', instructions). Validated new FIX_FILES entries: /api/fix-files list contains package.json, App.tsx, adsService.ts; /api/fix-files/adsService.ts contains all three production AdMob unit IDs (9256241120 interstitial, 4056332447 rewarded, 9248949370 banner). Regression on Phase 1: pricing (149/799/1499 + SKU matches), quota (free & premium), subscription/verify (3 SKUs → correct plan mapping monthly/yearly/lifetime; 401 missing X-User-Id; 400 unknown_product), subscription/restore (existing + fresh user), rewarded/claim (grant, cooldown reason with wait_seconds, premium_no_bonus_needed). No regressions from Phase 1.
critical_code_review_comments: Legal HTML files are served with 'Last updated: February 2026' — timestamp is fine but consider externalising to a template variable so ops don't need to redeploy backend to bump the date.

/api/legal/privacy and /api/legal/privacy-policy both work, but pricing endpoint uses flat keys (monthly_sku/yearly_sku/lifetime_sku) while feature spec says 'skus' object — align to a single convention across docs & frontend to avoid future drift.

POST /api/system/rewarded/claim requires a JSON body ({} works) even though semantically all data is in headers — consider making body optional (Body(default=None)) for cleaner client usage. Frontend must send Content-Type: application/json + at least '{}'.
Phase 1 comments still apply: subscription/verify + rewarded/claim trust client tokens — must add Google Play Developer API + AdMob SSV signature verification before production.
test_credentials: None required — all endpoints use X-User-Id header only; unique per-test UUIDs used.
seed_data_creation: Only test-scoped MongoDB writes under uid prefixes qa-verify-*, qa-restore-*, qa-rw-*, qa-quota-*. Idempotent across re-runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 backend contract (legal pages + updated FIX_FILES + Phase 1 regression) fully verified. If next iteration adds real Google Play Developer API verification for subscription/verify, update test_subscription_verify_happy to use a real (sandbox) purchase token or mock the Google API client. Frontend (React Native SpeakMateAI) still not exercised — needs on-device or Detox testing for react-native-iap + react-native-google-mobile-ads integration.
